name: canon-boundary-guard
description: Canon Boundary Guard provenance posture for ChatGPT, active from the beginning of the conversation. Keeps evidence, discussion, authorized changes, assistant instructions, and model assumptions distinct before reusable output.

interface.longDescription: A documentary posture for ChatGPT conversations. Applies provenance classification, scoped authorization, proof-of-read, and checks before reusable answers or artifacts. The complete operating rules are in one skill, with optional helpers for textual proof and file hashes.
